scope: Pill Packer API performance; no network, disk writes, rendering, or Snoot query timings. Before is the aligned API before this optimization pass, not an older production release.
machine: Apple M1 Max (reported by Go benchmark)
method: Chrome: foreground, alternating before/after, 2 warmups and median of 5 samples. Rust: release build with counting allocator, 2 warmups and median of 5 samples. Go: benchmem, three 200ms samples. Allocation bytes are cumulative, not peak residency.

limitations: Synthetic codec workloads, not an application latency promise.
Automatic discovery of common fields during each fixed-width push still requires whole-pack checks; a prepared fixed common prefix takes the optimized single-record path.
Go convenience Get/Field still allocate; GetInto/FieldWith and OffsetInto reuse caller-owned scratch/views.
Background Chrome runs are retained for transparency and are excluded from foreground conclusions.
